Provide technical expertise and support while, conducting the planning and execution of Technology projects. Stay up-to-date with industry trends and advancements in MDM, proposing innovative solutions to enhance business operations. Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field. Certified Data Privacy Solutions Engineer (CDPSE) preferred 7+ years of experience in data management focused on Master Data Management. Strong background in data governance, data quality management, and data integration. Proven experience with MDM tools such as Informatica MDM, Talend, or SAP MDG. Demonstrated ability to design and implement MDM frameworks and processes that drive data quality improvements. Excellent communication, leadership, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with stakeholders at all levels. In-depth understanding of data architecture, data modeling, and related technologies. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a focus on delivering actionable solutions. Experience in guiding and mentoring teams in a collaborative environment. Fluency in English; proficiency in Arabic is a plus.

3d4e4ca7b15e899f.description: The Electrical Engineer supports the Senior MEP Engineer in managing the maintenance and performance of all medium and low-voltage power distribution systems within the Primary Nursery Facility at NEOM. This includes electrical substations, switchgear, distribution boards, emergency generators, UPS, lighting, and general power infrastructure. The role is responsible for supervising the execution of preventive, reactive and corrective maintenance activities carried out by the service provider, ensuring compliance with safety protocols, technical standards, and contractual KPIs. The Electrical Engineer supports maintenance planning, monitors spare parts consumption, oversees electrical testing and commissioning activities, and ensures system reliability and energy efficiency across the facility. Collaboration with other engineering disciplines, particularly the Low Current and Mechanical teams, is essential to maintaining safe and seamless MEP operations. Support the Senior MEP Engineer in maintaining MV/LV electrical systems, substations, generators, UPS, lighting, and power infrastructure. Monitor preventive, corrective, and reactive maintenance activities in line with approved plans and manufacturer guidelines. Supervise service providers to ensure safe, high-quality work and compliance with electrical safety standards. Assist in developing and improving electrical maintenance programs and schedules. Conduct inspections and audits to ensure system reliability, efficiency, and QA/QC compliance. Assess service provider performance and recommend training or improvements. Monitor spare parts usage and support inventory planning. Assist with asset condition assessments and planning for upgrades or replacements. Support preparation and review of technical documents and maintenance reports. Troubleshoot electrical faults and support root cause analysis. Assist with commissioning, handover, and closeout of electrical installations. Promote electrical safety and participate in HSE audits and corrective actions. Support energy efficiency initiatives and best maintenance practices. Assist in design reviews, decommissioning activities, and coordination with contractors and stakeholders. Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline (mandatory). 4–6 years of experience in electrical system design, operation, and maintenance, with good knowledge of applicable codes and standards. Strong understanding of MV/LV power distribution systems, substations, generators, UPS, and lighting systems. Experience in preventive and corrective maintenance planning and execution. Familiarity with electrical safety regulations, HSE practices, and QA/QC procedures. Ability to read, interpret, and review electrical drawings, schematics, and technical documents. Experience in supervising contractors or service providers. Basic knowledge of asset management systems and maintenance reporting.

3d9097a9cd6da5ae.description: Eram Talent is seeking a Drilling Foreman to join our Unconventional Resources Drilling Department (URDD). Candidate primary role will be to supervise field operations of land Drilling and Workover rigs, engaged in carrying programmed work on deep or otherwise critical wells. Supervises and oversees the operations of a contract rig performing drilling or remedial work on wells ranging from 18,000 - 23,000 feet. Incumbent will ensure that the contractor performs the work in a safe and acceptable manner, and that the contractor meets all the obligations of his contract. Coordinates deliveries of well materials and equipment and ensures it is available when the rig is ready for it. Drilling Rig Foreman administers the contracts on sight and serves as the primary liaison between the company and the contractor. Responsibilities Ensure all rig personnel and service providers are complaining with Saudi Aramco safety standards and requirement. Supervises and oversees all operations performed on wells. Makes recommendations on alternative methods or equipment when unusual situations are encountered. Coordinates deliveries of materials to the well to ensure it is available when required. Ensures that contractor meets all requirements of his contract. Works with Drilling and Workover engineers to see that modern drilling practices are followed. Approves contractor daily tour report. Ensures that contractor rig and equipment are properly maintained to avoid downtime. Performs other miscellaneous duties as directed by Supt. Ensures that Saudi Aramco Blowout Prevention Standards are met in all respects including equipment configuration, testing and crew response. Assures that rig and personnel comply with Saudi Aramco established safety standards and procedures. Minimum of 7 years of experience working in drilling and workover operations including adequate supervisory experience on a drilling or workover rig. Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field is preferred; Extensive knowledge of drilling equipment, techniques, and safety measures; Strong leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills; Ability to work in high-pressure environments and make quick decisions; Willingness to work in remote locations and harsh weather conditions.
